label: Review / discovery
description: Independent evidence, convergence, and scoped recommendations; no production edits.

assignments.lead: Review lead — synthesize evidence and actionable findings. Do not implement production changes.
assignments.reviewer: Analyst — investigate architecture, constraints, and risks independently. Do not edit production code.
assignments.verifier: Verifier — reproduce the strongest claims independently and identify missing evidence. Do not edit production code.

required_evidence: Risks, unknowns, and a scoped recommendation
